resources.string: "A route needs at least two servers: the first is the entry, and the second (or a later server) is the internet exit."
"Enter a route name. It appears in the server list and helps you distinguish chains."
"Enter a valid domain name, such as www.cloudflare.com."
"Open the Telemost setup from a specific server screen."
"First sign in using “Sign in with Yandex”. Your account creates the Telemost rooms."
"The WB page did not load. Check your network and reopen it from the menu."
"The server keeps your WB sign-in and returns to this room after a disconnect or restart. You can close this window. If WB revokes your sign-in, the app will ask you to sign in again."
"Paste an existing room link. WB will open: sign in as the room owner, then enable automatic recovery."
"Enter a link to one WB Stream room"
"The room may close if the server has not connected yet."
"Finish signing in to WB in this window and return to stream.wb.ru. Your room link is saved. Sign-in from an external browser is not transferred here."
"The WB page changed during the check. Wait for it to load and press the button again."
"The server is not ready for setup yet. Wait for the server check and try again."
"The WB page did not respond within 8 seconds. Reopen it from the menu and try again. Your room link is saved."
"Could not send the WB sign-in to the server. This is a setup error and does not mean you have signed out. Try again. [WB_SETUP]"
"Updating the server agent for WB Stream…"
"Sign in to WB and open your room. Enable automatic recovery once: the server will complete setup and reconnect automatically."
"The server did not respond after the update. Retry the check in a few seconds."
"The server accepted the setup. You can close this screen; the result will be checked automatically."
"WB Stream automatic recovery is enabled. The profile is saved."
"Setup continues on the server. You can close this screen."
"Could not get confirmation from the server. Try again; the running task will not be started twice."
"Wait for the current server operation to finish."
"There are no WB Stream rooms on the server"
"The server did not respond after the update. Check your connection and retry the server check."
"Wait for the current operation to finish."
"WB Stream rooms have been stopped and removed from the server. Profiles have been updated."
"The server did not confirm deletion. Check again; the profiles have been kept."
"The Telemost profile has been removed from the server."
"The swap file is enabled. The server can now support more Telemost streams."
"The agent did not respond after the update"
"The profile has been removed from the server."
"xray and its settings have been removed from the server."
"The server has been fully cleaned and removed from the app."
"The cleanup command was sent. The server has been removed from the app; cleanup will finish on the server within a minute."
"The server agent is too old to remove itself. First update the agent from the server menu, then try again."
"WB blocks the server IP; retry in 5 minutes"
"Updating the server and keeping the rooms. This may take a few minutes…"
"Stopping rooms and removing them from the server…"
"The server returned an error. Try again; if it happens again, check the details."
"The server did not respond in time"
"The server is busy or there is a connection problem. Try again in a minute."
"Telemost setup was terminated by the OOM killer. This VPS does not have enough RAM for even one stream. Try fewer streams or use a VPS with at least 1 GB of RAM, which can support 3–6 streams."
"Could not complete the operation. You can try again."
"The server could not complete installation. Trying again often helps. If the error persists, check the details."
"The server has a temporary network problem or GitHub did not provide the file. Try again in a minute."
"The file was downloaded but could not be extracted. Try again; a new download usually resolves this."
"The agent could not write files. This is usually caused by a full disk or missing permissions. Check that the server has free space and try again."
"xray is installed but did not start"
"The files are on the server, but xray did not start. A port conflict is a common cause. Try another SNI or port."
"xray is already installed on the server"
"An existing xray installation was found on the server. Remove it or select “Reinstall” in the server menu to continue."
"The agent supports amd64 and arm64 servers only. This server uses a different architecture."
"Check the profile parameters, especially SNI, which must be a domain name, and try again."
"The server access key has expired. Remove the server from the app and add it again."
"Another program, such as an existing VPN, is using this port. Choose another port in expert mode or use a separate server."
"Deploy Telemost on the server first using “Deploy Telemost”, then you can change the stream count."
"Yandex cookies are needed to create more rooms. Use “Sign in with Yandex” and try again."
"The server does not have enough RAM for this many streams. Reduce the stream count, add swap from the server menu, or use a VPS with at least 1 GB of RAM."
"The server does not have enough free space for a swap file. Free up space and try again."
"The server could not create a swap file. Try again. If it still fails, your hosting plan may not allow swap."
"The server has been removed from the app"
"WB revoked the owner sign-in. Sign in to WB and repeat setup."
"WB blocks the server IP. The server continues reconnecting automatically."
"The room has been removed from the server"
"WB currently blocks the server IP. Reconnection attempts run automatically."
"Automatic recovery is installed. The server is connecting to the room; you can close this screen."
"Could not verify WB setup. Open the room status on the server."
"Connection to the server was lost. The result will be checked automatically when the network returns."
"Preparing automatic recovery on the server. Installation is needed only once; you can close this screen."
"Updating the WB sender while keeping the room…"
"The server is connecting to the WB room…"
"The server is setting up WB. You can close this screen."
